mapper.select: select distinct m.key from sys_menu m left join sys_role_menu rm on m.id = rm.menu_id left join sys_user_role ur on rm.role_id = ur.role_id left join sys_role r on r.id = ur.role_id where m.status = '1' and r.status = '1' and ur.user_id = #{userId}
select distinct sm.* from sys_menu sm inner join sys_tenant_menu stm on sm.id = stm.menu_id where sm.deleted = 0 and sm.status = 1 order by sm.sort_no
